quests.title: Heidi - Trickster Registration
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.1: The Start of an Adventure (Coral Beach)
quests.prereqText: None (Character Creation Spawn)
steps: Speak to Heidi in Coral Town - Blooming Cora upon spawning to receive 1x Registration Form.
Walk a short distance in Blooming Cora and speak to Bunny Maid to turn in the Registration Form.
quests.notes: Equip your Rookie Sword, Hat, and Shield right away before heading out to Coral Beach Field 1.

quests.title: Bunny Maid - Prove Your Spirit!
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.1: The Start of an Adventure (Coral Beach)
quests.prereqText: Heidi - Trickster Registration
steps: Speak to Bunny Maid in Coral Town - Blooming Cora.
Exit to Coral Beach Field 1 - Blue Wave and hunt Torobbie (Lv.1) until you collect 2x Baby Carrot.
Return to Blooming Cora and give 2x Baby Carrot to Bunny Maid.

quests.title: Bunny Maid - Helping Others
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.1: The Start of an Adventure (Coral Beach)
quests.prereqText: Bunny Maid - Prove Your Spirit!
steps: Speak to Bunny Maid in Coral Town - Blooming Cora.
Find and talk to Winnie in Coral Town - Blooming Cora.

quests.title: Winnie - Winnie's Request
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.1: The Start of an Adventure (Coral Beach)
quests.prereqText: Bunny Maid - Helping Others
steps: Speak to Winnie in Coral Town - Blooming Cora.
Go to Coral Beach Field 1 - Blue Wave and speak to Lifeguard Deen (in front of the Lifeguard Building).

quests.title: Lifeguard Deen - Deen's Request - 1
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.1: The Start of an Adventure (Coral Beach)
quests.prereqText: Winnie - Winnie's Request
steps: Accept the monster hunt from Lifeguard Deen in Coral Beach Field 1 - Blue Wave.
Hunt 5x Tottochi (Lv.2) within 10 minutes on Coral Beach Field 1 - Blue Wave.
Report back to Lifeguard Deen.

quests.title: Lifeguard Deen - Deen's Request - 2
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.1: The Start of an Adventure (Coral Beach)
quests.prereqText: Lifeguard Deen - Deen's Request - 1
steps: Speak to Lifeguard Deen in Coral Beach Field 1 - Blue Wave.
Take the portal to Coral Beach Field 2 - Passionate Sun and talk to Tinnie (by the Beach Volleyball Court).

quests.title: Tinnie - Tinnie's Request - 1
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.1: The Start of an Adventure (Coral Beach)
quests.prereqText: Lifeguard Deen - Deen's Request - 2
steps: Accept the monster hunt from Tinnie in Coral Beach Field 2 - Passionate Sun.
Hunt 5x Bad Fury (Lv.4) within 10 minutes on Coral Beach Field 2 - Passionate Sun.
Report back to Tinnie.

quests.title: Tinnie - Tinnie's Request - 2
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.1: The Start of an Adventure (Coral Beach)
quests.prereqText: Tinnie - Tinnie's Request - 1
steps: Speak to Tinnie in Coral Beach Field 2 - Passionate Sun.
Proceed to Coral Beach Field 3 - Sunny Beach and talk to Lifeguard Bean (standing in front of a pond).

quests.title: Lifeguard Bean - Bean's Request
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.1: The Start of an Adventure (Coral Beach)
quests.prereqText: Tinnie - Tinnie's Request - 2
steps: Speak to Lifeguard Bean in Coral Beach Field 3 - Sunny Beach.
Hunt Blue Penguin (Lv.6) in Coral Beach Field 3 - Sunny Beach to collect 5x Cool Ice.
Return to Lifeguard Bean and turn in 5x Cool Ice to complete Episode 0: Chapter 1!
quests.notes: Completes Episode 0: Chapter 1 - The Start of an Adventure! Equip your Pocket Pouch immediately for extra inventory capacity.

quests.title: Lifeguard Bean - Meet Don Giuvanni
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.1: The Start of an Adventure (Coral Beach)
quests.prereqText: Lifeguard Bean - Bean's Request
steps: Speak to Lifeguard Bean in Coral Beach Field 3 - Sunny Beach.
Before leaving Coral Beach, complete the Level 10-12 Coral Beach quests if desired, then walk through Coral Beach - Dark Cave (or use Pachi in Blooming Cora) to reach Gate of Desert Beach.
Talk to Don Giuvanni in Gate of Desert Beach.

quests.title: Driller Marky - Master Drilling! (Sub-Quest)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.2: Don Giuvanni's Push (Desert Beach)
quests.prereqText: Lifeguard Bean - Meet Don Giuvanni (Lv.13+)
steps: Speak to Don Giuvanni at Gate of Desert Beach to start 'Don Giuvanni's Training Pt. 1'.
Speak to Driller Marky standing next to Don Giuvanni at Gate of Desert Beach.
Drill in the sand at Gate of Desert Beach (Depth 10m, Sand) until you find 2x Tanning Oil.
Return 2x Tanning Oil to Driller Marky to receive Drilling for Dummies and Peng (Pet).

quests.title: Don Giuvanni - Don Giuvanni's Training Pt. 1
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.2: Don Giuvanni's Push (Desert Beach)
quests.prereqText: Driller Marky - Master Drilling!
steps: Hand over 1x Drilling for Dummies (from Driller Marky) to Don Giuvanni at Gate of Desert Beach.

source.from: Reward from Driller Marky - Master Drilling!

quests.title: Don Giuvanni - Meet Officer Robert
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.2: Don Giuvanni's Push (Desert Beach)
quests.prereqText: Don Giuvanni - Don Giuvanni's Training Pt. 1
steps: Speak to Don Giuvanni at Gate of Desert Beach.
Travel through Desert Beach Field 1 to Beach Town - Paradise and speak to Officer Robert.

quests.title: Officer Robert - Don Giuvanni's Training Pt. 2
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.2: Don Giuvanni's Push (Desert Beach)
quests.prereqText: Don Giuvanni - Meet Officer Robert
steps: Speak to Officer Robert in Beach Town - Paradise.
Enter Paradise Shop and talk to Compounder Paul.
Compound 1x Desert Potion using 1x Oasis Water + 1x Distilled Water + 1x Empty Potion Bottle (given by previous quests).
Bring 1x Desert Potion back to Officer Robert.

source.from: Compounder Paul: 1x Oasis Water + 1x Distilled Water + 1x Empty Potion Bottle

quests.title: Alchemist Nate - Let's Try Maturing Compounding! (Sub-Quest)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.2: Don Giuvanni's Push (Desert Beach)
quests.prereqText: Active Officer Robert - Don's Push - 3rd Stage
steps: Accept 'Don's Push - 3rd Stage' from Officer Robert in Beach Town - Paradise.
Enter Paradise Shop and speak to Alchemist Nate.
Use Alchemist Nate's compounding service to compound your Life Vest with 1x Hard Scales (received from Don Giuvanni's Training Pt. 2; extra Hard Scales drop from Fanta Fish Lv.21 in Field 2).
Talk to Alchemist Nate again to receive Nate's Certification.

source.from: Alchemist Nate: 1x Life Vest + 1x Hard Scales

quests.title: Officer Robert - Don's Push - 3rd Stage
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.2: Don Giuvanni's Push (Desert Beach)
quests.prereqText: Alchemist Nate - Let's Try Maturing Compounding!
steps: Bring 1x Nate's Certification from Alchemist Nate back to Officer Robert in Beach Town - Paradise.

source.from: Reward from Alchemist Nate - Let's Try Maturing Compounding!

quests.title: Blacksmith Marx - Learn to Refine! (Sub-Quest)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.2: Don Giuvanni's Push (Desert Beach)
quests.prereqText: Active Officer Robert - Don's Push - 4th Stage
steps: Accept 'Don's Push - 4th Stage' from Officer Robert in Beach Town - Paradise.
Enter Paradise Shop and speak to Blacksmith Marx.
Go to 1st Mining Lot of Crystal Copper (entered via Desert Beach Field 3 - Statue of Anubis) and drill 7x Bronze Fragment (Depth 10~20m, Rock).
Return 7x Bronze Fragment to Blacksmith Marx to receive Refining Guide, 7x Bronze Fragment, and Wooden Sword.

quests.title: Officer Robert - Don's Push - 4th Stage
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.2: Don Giuvanni's Push (Desert Beach)
quests.prereqText: Blacksmith Marx - Learn to Refine!
steps: Use Blacksmith Marx's refining service in Paradise Shop to refine your Wooden Sword to Level 1 using 1x Bronze Fragment.
Bring 1x Refining Guide and the Refined Lv.1 Wooden Sword to Officer Robert in Beach Town - Paradise to complete Episode 0: Chapter 2!

source.from: Reward from Blacksmith Marx - Learn to Refine!
Refined at Blacksmith Marx with Bronze Fragment

quests.notes: Completes Episode 0: Chapter 2 - Don Giuvanni's Push!

quests.title: Andrew - Meet the Natives! (Chapter 3 Main Quest)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.3: Our Prologue (8 Heart Gems)
quests.prereqText: Level 20+, Officer Robert - Don's Push - 4th Stage
steps: Speak to Andrew in Beach Town - Paradise to begin Episode 0: Chapter 3 - Our Prologue.
Complete all 8 resident quests below (7 in Beach Town - Paradise and Old Artist in Desert Beach Field 2). Note: Your own character class's NPC gives a special class version that awards a Pet + Ring!
Turn in all 8x Heart Gem to Andrew in Beach Town - Paradise.

source.from: 1x from each of the 8 Chapter 3 NPCs below
source.map: Beach Town - Paradise & Desert Beach Field 2

quests.notes: Select your character class in the top bar to automatically filter the 8 NPC quests below to the exact versions your character will play!

quests.title: Steve Ryu - Helping Confess (Non-Bunny Classes)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.3: Our Prologue (8 Heart Gems)
quests.prereqText: Active Andrew - Meet the Natives! (Any class EXCEPT Bunny)
steps: Speak to Steve Ryu in Beach Town - Paradise.
Hunt Hula Octopus (Lv.25/27) in Desert Beach Field 3 or Field 4 to collect 3x Bouquet.
Return 3x Bouquet to Steve Ryu for 1x Heart Gem.

quests.title: Steve Ryu - Wacky Confession & Mermaid Babe - The Mark of Love! (Bunny Only)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.3: Our Prologue (8 Heart Gems)
quests.prereqText: Active Andrew - Meet the Natives! (Bunny Class Only)
steps: Speak to Steve Ryu in Beach Town - Paradise to receive 1x Written Challenge.
Go to Desert Beach Field 2 - Sand Palace and speak to Mermaid Babe to start 'The Mark of Love!'.
Drill 3x Red Lipstick in Desert Beach Field 2 - Sand Palace (10m, Sand) and give them + Written Challenge to Mermaid Babe for 1x Handkerchief of Challenge (+35,392 Base / 10,032 TM EXP).
Return 1x Handkerchief of Challenge to Steve Ryu in Paradise.

source.from: Reward from Mermaid Babe - The Mark of Love!

quests.title: Don Giuvanni - A Famous Model's Picture (Non-Cat Classes)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.3: Our Prologue (8 Heart Gems)
quests.prereqText: Active Andrew - Meet the Natives! (Any class EXCEPT Cat)
steps: Speak to Don Giuvanni in Beach Town - Paradise.
Drill in Desert Beach Field 1 - Delta Island (10m, Sand) to find 1x Jenny's Photo B.
Return 1x Jenny's Photo B to Don Giuvanni.

quests.title: Don Giuvanni - Enemies in a Place like this? (Cat Only)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.3: Our Prologue (8 Heart Gems)
quests.prereqText: Active Andrew - Meet the Natives! (Cat Class Only)
steps: Speak to Don Giuvanni in Beach Town - Paradise.
Hunt Shell Trap (Lv.19) in Desert Beach Field 1 - Delta Island to collect 3x Clam Meat.
Return 3x Clam Meat to Don Giuvanni.

quests.title: Clever Owl - The Owl's Worry (Non-Sheep Classes)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.3: Our Prologue (8 Heart Gems)
quests.prereqText: Active Andrew - Meet the Natives! (Any class EXCEPT Sheep)
steps: Speak to Clever Owl in Beach Town - Paradise.
Hunt Golden Mole (Lv.20) in Desert Beach Field 1 - Delta Island to collect 3x Golden Mole Feather.
Return 3x Golden Mole Feather to Clever Owl.

quests.title: Clever Owl - The Owl from that Time (Sheep Only)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.3: Our Prologue (8 Heart Gems)
quests.prereqText: Active Andrew - Meet the Natives! (Sheep Class Only)
steps: Speak to Clever Owl in Beach Town - Paradise.
Drill in Desert Beach Field 1 - Delta Island (10m, Sand) to find 1x Magic Sealed Letter.
Return 1x Magic Sealed Letter to Clever Owl.

quests.title: Kristoffer J. - Weird Fisherman (Non-Fox Classes)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.3: Our Prologue (8 Heart Gems)
quests.prereqText: Active Andrew - Meet the Natives! (Any class EXCEPT Fox)
steps: Speak to Kristoffer J. in Beach Town - Paradise.
Drill in Desert Beach Field 1 - Delta Island (10m, Sand) to collect 3x Salt.
Return 3x Salt to Kristoffer J.

quests.title: Kristoffer J. - Fished Up Scroll (Fox Only)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.3: Our Prologue (8 Heart Gems)
quests.prereqText: Active Andrew - Meet the Natives! (Fox Class Only)
steps: Speak to Kristoffer J. in Beach Town - Paradise.
Hunt Golden Mole (Lv.20) in Desert Beach Field 1 - Delta Island to collect 3x Earthworm.
Return 3x Earthworm to Kristoffer J.

quests.title: Dorothy - A Present for a Sick Friend (1) (Non-Lion Classes)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.3: Our Prologue (8 Heart Gems)
quests.prereqText: Active Andrew - Meet the Natives! (Any class EXCEPT Lion)
steps: Speak to Dorothy in Beach Town - Paradise.
Hunt Sea Scorpion (Lv.22) in Desert Beach Field 2 or Field 3 to collect 3x Scorpion Jerky.
Return 3x Scorpion Jerky to Dorothy.

quests.title: Dorothy - Guardian of Dreams (Lion Only)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.3: Our Prologue (8 Heart Gems)
quests.prereqText: Active Andrew - Meet the Natives! (Lion Class Only)
steps: Speak to Dorothy in Beach Town - Paradise.
Hunt Fanta Slime (Lv.18) in Gate of Desert Beach or Desert Beach Field 1 to collect 3x Twinkle Star.
Return 3x Twinkle Star to Dorothy.

quests.title: Officer Tera - Help Keep the Peace (Non-Buffalo) / An Unexpected Encounter (Buffalo)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.3: Our Prologue (8 Heart Gems)
quests.prereqText: Active Andrew - Meet the Natives! (All Classes)
steps: Speak to Officer Tera in Beach Town - Paradise.
Hunt Grumpy Octopus (Lv.29) in Desert Beach Field 4 - Parasol River (Haunted House) to collect 3x Illegal CD.
Return 3x Illegal CD to Officer Tera.

items: Non-Buffalo: 1x Buffalo Card | Buffalo Only: 1x Buffalo Calf (Pet) + 1x Strong Ring

quests.title: Old Artist - Cherishing Destinies (Non-Dragon) / The Painter from Notre Dame (Dragon)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.3: Our Prologue (8 Heart Gems)
quests.prereqText: Active Andrew - Meet the Natives! (All Classes)
steps: Speak to Old Artist in Desert Beach Field 2 - Sand Palace.
Collect 1x Paper (drilled in Desert Beach Field 2, 10m Sand, or bought at Gate of Desert Beach / Paradise Shop) and 2x Color Pencils (dropped by Fanta Fish Lv.21 in Field 2).
Return 1x Paper and 2x Color Pencils to Old Artist.

source.from: Drill Depth 10m (Sand) or Buy in Paradise Shop

items: Non-Dragon: 1x Dragon Card + 10x Pink Potion B | Dragon Only: 1x Dragon Whelp (Pet) + 1x Smart Ring

quests.title: Rosemary - Lookin' Good! (Non-Raccoon Classes)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.3: Our Prologue (8 Heart Gems)
quests.prereqText: Active Andrew - Meet the Natives! (Any class EXCEPT Raccoon)
steps: Speak to Rosemary in Beach Town - Paradise.
Drill in Desert Beach Field 2 - Sand Palace (10m, Sand) to collect 2x Swimsuit.
Return 2x Swimsuit to Rosemary.

quests.title: Rosemary - Runaway Student (Raccoon Only)
quests.chapter: Episode 0 - Ch.3: Our Prologue (8 Heart Gems)
quests.prereqText: Active Andrew - Meet the Natives! (Raccoon Class Only)
steps: Speak to Rosemary in Beach Town - Paradise.
Hunt Fanta Fish (Lv.21) in Desert Beach Field 2 for 2x Pen and drill/buy 2x Paper.
Return 2x Pen and 2x Paper to Rosemary.

source.from: Drill Depth 10m (Sand) or Buy in Paradise Shop
